description: The Lost Pages Find the 12 missing pages of the Shredder Operating Manual, and put them together to form Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Return the pages to Gurda Ragescar near Splintertree Post. Requirements: - Shredder Operating Manual - Chapter 1 - Shredder Operating Manual - Chapter 2 - Shredder Operating Manual - Chapter 3
name: The Lost Pages
